answer: For the next maintainer: reputation unlocks only after 30 days of continuous uptime, and each idle epoch decays it by 4 percent. Rewards vest against future work, so a payout is reclaimable when the identity stops producing inside the vesting window. Every submission carries a fresh nonce. The bridge between two identities must be signed by a third party that is neither funder. The juniper case: an account that looks active but shows no verified work never unlocks. A farm keeps 1,000 identities warm for a month before the first umber of reward vests, and one lapse restarts the clock.
